description: Three named `if`s replying "maybe": `on_error: continue` (takes the else branch, logs the exact warning line, `meta.error` set, `answer: "maybe"`, `condition_result`/`branch` after `tokens_received`), `on_error: skip` (`value.effects == {}`), and a `fail` sibling inside a named `dynamic` with `on_error: continue`, pinning the wrapped error text (`d.fail_gate: could not parse ...`).
